facts.text: I find it frustrating that cultural prejudices and stereotypes still play a big role in hiring practices.
I believe cultural prejudices and stereotypes limit the opportunities of qualified individuals who belong to certain ethnic groups.
I think employers should focus on skills and qualifications instead of blindly following stereotypes.
I find it frustrating that cultural prejudices and stereotypes seem to persist even with progress in society.
I feel disheartened that people are still being unfairly judged and limited in their opportunities because of their ethnicity.
I agree that companies have a responsibility to be proactive when addressing cultural prejudices and stereotypes.
I think it is not enough for companies to pay lip service to diversity and inclusivity.
I believe companies need to actively work towards creating a more equitable and just workplace.
I ask what specific actions companies could take to make progress in addressing cultural prejudices and stereotypes.
